text:
alex.chang: Hey team — NovaHealth POC go-ahead. Need billing org + project, $2k free credit applied, and a spend cap for the POC.
alex.chang: Also need 2 Hosted API keys (dev + demo), one ephemeral key for their partner integration, and a request for a small Dedicated pool (1xA10G equivalent) behind the POC org. @maria.santiago can you handle provisioning + API keys? ETA?

maria.santiago: Copy. Plan:
- create billing org: nova-poc-org
- create project: nova-poc-project
- apply promotional credit: 2000 USD
- set spend cap on project: 5000 USD (blocking) OR notify only — need confirmation from FinOps
- create two long-lived API keys + one ephemeral key with TTL=24h
- request dedicated pool, will open capacity request ticket w/ infra
ETA for hosted keys + billing org: same day. Dedicated pool depends on infra (24–72h typical).

alex.chang: Please make the spend cap blocking if possible — customer legal wants a strict cap for the trial.

jay.kim: Quick FinOps note: default "spend cap" in our hosted flow is a soft block (alerts + pausing new provisioning) unless we opt-in to enforce a hard block on token generation. We can do hard block at the project level but need approval from finance owner. If you want hard block, tag me and I'll sign off.
jay.kim: For immediate safety we usually do:
1) project-level quota: tokens_per_minute = 5000
2) project monthly quota = 500000 tokens (~estimated ~3–4k USD depending on model)
3) webhook alerts to /internal/finops/billing-alerts

maria.santiago: Example API we use internally to create billing project (for ops automation):

```
POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/billing/orgs
{
  "org_id": "nova-poc-org",
  "display_name": "NovaHealth POC",
  "promotional_credit_usd": 2000,
  "project": {
    "project_id": "nova-poc-project",
    "spend_cap_usd": 5000,
    "hard_block": true,
    "quotas": {
      "tokens_month": 500000,
      "tokens_per_minute": 5000
    }
  },
  "contact": "alex.chang@redwood.ai"
}
```

maria.santiago: For keys — we'll generate:
- nova-poc-dev (long-lived, restricted to models: gpt-3.5, gpt-4-small)
- nova-poc-demo (long-lived, read-only usage for demo)
- nova-poc-ephemeral (ttl=86400s, usage limited to demo IP ranges)

samira.odell: On Dedicated/VPC side: need the customer's allowed CIDR and whether they want VPC peering or private link. Also confirm the service account name so we can set IAM roles for the pool.
samira.odell: Example VPC info we need:
- customer_vpc_cidr: 10.10.0.0/16
- allowed_ingress_ips: [list]
- peer_type: peering | private-link

alex.chang: I'll get the CIDR from NovaHealth and put it in the ticket.

jay.kim: One more — credits application: promo credits are charged against invoice automatically but do not show up as a separate billing line externally. We record credits at org level. If we set hard_block=true, token generation will be blocked once the spend_cap_usd is reached. If you prefer a safer approach, set hard_block=false and enforce via webhook that quarantines keys when threshold hit.

maria.santiago: Tagging infra: @deploy-bot — opening dedicated pool request for nova-poc-project, size=1xA10G, zone=us-west-2a, expected lead-time 48h.

deploy-bot: [automated] CREATED ticket #DP-4821 for dedicated pool request (nova-poc-project). Estimated ETA: 48 hours. Assignee: infra-capacity.

alex.chang: Perfect. Next steps:
- jay to confirm hard_block approval
- maria to create org/project + keys when approved
- samira to collect VPC details from customer and attach to DP ticket

jay.kim: I approve hard_block for this POC. I'll open the finance sign-off now.
jay.kim: Also set billing webhook to slack channel #finops-alerts and email finance-ops@redwood.ai

maria.santiago: On it, I'll proceed once I see finance sign-off. Will paste the created keys here (masked) and the org_id/project_id.

alex.chang: Thanks all :thumbsup:
